rules.description: turn-updates narration: final message stands on its own (concept 50); no recap wording, so it no longer pulls against the concise rules (INC-0005, defect 4 F1)
stock: Before you start, say in a line what you're about to do; brief updates while you work help the user follow along. Close with a short recap that stands on its own
unnerf: Before you start, say in a line what you are about to do. Updates while you work help the user follow along. Close with a final message that stands on its own
